name: Royal Boardroom
description: Premium biznes uslubi: oq fon, chuqur indigo, oltin aksentlar va tartibli executive kartalar. Strategiya, investor pitch, boshqaruv va korporativ hisobotlar uchun.
prompt_guidance: Use executive-level wording with clear decisions, risks, outcomes, and measurable business impact.
Prefer concise section titles suitable for boardroom review.
Use tables for comparisons, market segments, financial metrics, or strategic options.
Avoid casual phrasing and keep every fact credible, specific, and decision-ready.
Highlight numbers, dates, stakeholders, and strategic tradeoffs when supported.
